description: This file defines a React functional component that serves as a layout wrapper for authenticated pages in a Next.js application. It manages path resolution for the active link state in the sidebar by determining the current pathname from headers, prioritizing 'next-url' over 'x-invoke-path', and defaults to root if neither is available.

methods.name: AppGroupLayout
methods.description: React functional component that wraps content with AppLayout, determining current pathname from headers for consistent active link highlighting.
